changes_made.explanation: Consolidated tasks to 'Other:Question Answering' since both extractive and generative QA are covered under this umbrella. Normalized model names and removed duplicates/variants. Added T5 which is explicitly mentioned for generative QA experiments.
Normalized metric names to base forms and removed 'Time (ms)' which is not an NLG evaluation metric but rather a performance measurement.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation is conducted in this paper. The paper uses LLMs for generation but not for evaluation.
No human evaluation is mentioned in the paper. All evaluations are conducted using automatic metrics.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on test-time adaptation for question answering models, addressing both extractive and generative QA. The main contributions are methodological improvements to prevent model collapse during adaptation. The evaluation is primarily automatic (Exact Match and F1 scores) without human or LLM-as-judge assessment. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization and consolidation of duplicate entries.
